name: K0maru Agent Memory
description: FastMCP Stdio and CLI Services for AI Coding Agents

cli_commands.description: Initialize a local .k0maru/wiki workspace or bind an existing Obsidian vault; --install configures client configs and Git pre-commit hooks.
Incrementally index Markdown vault files into SQLite FTS5; optionally compute vector embeddings.
Assemble a bounded <300 token context loadout of project mission, core invariants, and recent decisions.
Search knowledge base using BM25 full-text search or semantic vector embeddings.
Evaluate code against active ADR invariants in <10ms; exit code 2 triggers autonomous agent self-healing.
List all active, parsed Living ADR invariant rules across the repository.
Crystallize decision notes or ADRs; --supersedes atomically deprecates old rules and hot-swaps active guards.
Diagnose repository bindings, hooks integrity, cache status, and MCP client configurations.
Start the FastMCP stdio server for Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, and Gemini CLI.
Clean orphaned entries in SQLite cache and compact vector storage.

mcp_tools.name: get_project_loadout
mcp_tools.description: Fetch high-priority architectural blueprint, core invariants, project vision, and recent ADR decision logs (<300 tokens) dynamically adjusted to git diff.

parameters.diff: boolean (whether to inspect uncommitted git diff)

mcp_tools.name: guard_check
mcp_tools.description: Audit git diff or code changes against active Living ADR architectural invariants and project rules (<10ms). Halts non-compliant commits.

parameters.diff: boolean (audit unstaged and staged git diff)
parameters.claude_stop_hook: boolean (Claude Code Stop-hook formatting with exit code 2 remediation)
parameters.path: string (path to single file to audit)

mcp_tools.name: recall_memory
mcp_tools.description: Search and retrieve documentation, technical research reports, project context, past architectural decisions, configurations, and notes.

parameters.limit: number (maximum number of notes to return)

mcp_tools.name: flush_session
mcp_tools.description: Crystallize technical decisions, verified bug fixes, architecture decisions (ADRs), or task milestones back into Markdown notes with optional deterministic supersession.

parameters.title: string (canonical note title)
parameters.supersedes: string (optional title of deprecated note to supersede)

mcp_tools.name: distill_session_skill
mcp_tools.description: Distill an execution trace, compilation error, or debugging session into a reusable troubleshooting playbook/skill note.
